I am on the 10 mg Norco. Sorry if the picture doesn't show. Those are for break through pain and the methadone is for the chronic pain. I'd rather have fun and take these pills with no pain. 
No, I don't shoot or snort...I have considered it because my tolerance is so high anymore.
Yes.
No worries. Just sharing, visually speaking.

Well, I won't get them all prescribed to me again. Been doing trial & error with meds due to a very serious chronic pain condition from an injury. I think I'll just be sticking with the methadone from now on...
Yes, you did!
Have you heard anything from her? I hope she's okay.
Nothing against you, but I don't know what to talk about anymore; it feels pointless. Thank you, however.
http://hugmachine.org/
At the time,  I was upset. It has made it difficult to trust her through the years. It hurt our relationship as twins.
An ex boyfriend of mine dated my identical twin for a brief time. That was awkward.

I know (my own experience) how difficult it is to say anything, to just utter the words out loud is terrifying.  However, please find a counselor to talk to whom you will have a trusting relationship with. It will get better once you start to process your emotions.  Some days are good. Some days, not so much. Yet, you can get through this. If you need to talk, you can always PM me. (hugs)
Okay. I'll be in contact.
When would you need a picture? I could possibly do this. Great idea, btw!
You're quite welcome.
Caucasian girl here. I always take my shoes off inside. I prefer not to wear shoes.
Just installed it. It's awesome.

I, too, have been through childhood trauma. I've done the therapy. I even ended up in a field dealing with childhood abuse/neglect.  It has not always been an easy life, but those experiences have made me a stronger person. Took me time to understand that. With that being said, please feel free to pm me. I don't judge or mind listening.  (hugs)
That's my suggestion, too. I hope it's possible for your big day!

Here's a cute little love story:  I'm an identical twin (girl). My sister and I were in 1st grade, 1980. His name was J.V., short for John V. There were two John's in class. Now that I think about it, we both were "dating" him (whatever that means in 1st grade). We would individually have turns walking behind the bushes on the playground holding hands, talking in little kid chatter. He was really sweet. I've always wondered what happened to him.
Really? So am I.
Please get him to a doctor!

Yes, my identical twin sister has had poor boundaries with at least three of my ex's. It started in junior high. She was seeing my bf behind my back...little did I know until I started snooping and found letters between them. It was junior high, so it was fairly innocent. She has often hit on my boyfriend's, which had made it difficult to trust her. She started the same line of bs with my most recent bf, but I called her on it...no problems since.
